choices.why: A distressed dark-brown leather three-seater with a boxy industrial profile, exactly the aged-leather look requested and sized to anchor the open loft space.
A solid wood top on a black metal sled frame, wide enough to sit well in front of the 218 cm sofa and matching the black-metal brief.
A black metal tube frame with warm honey wood shelves that echo the floor and beams, with no bright white or grey finishes.
A matte black swing-arm reading lamp with brass details, a classic industrial piece that pairs with leather and dark metal.
A large, warm rug with rust and earthy tones and a distressed finish, big enough to sit under both the sofa and the coffee table.
Charcoal woven cushions with beige flecks add texture to the brown leather without bringing in bright white.
A matte dark-grey pot that is sober and fits the dark-metal palette next to the back window.

answer.why: Aged brown leather, solid wood and black metal repeat across every piece and play off the exposed beams and the oak floor, while the earth-toned rug and dark textiles keep the industrial look warm and free of bright white.
